candidateReview.name: Magnolia Pizza And Pasta
candidateReview.note: Same pizza-and-pasta shop at 2120 W Emerson Pl in Magnolia as the on-file Magnolia Pizza & Pasta; this is just the permit-register spelling of the name.

candidateReview.name: Olympia Ii Pizza & Spaghetti
candidateReview.note: Same Wallingford restaurant at 4501 Interlake Ave N as the on-file Olympia Pizza & Spaghetti House II, run by the Christofilis family since it passed out of the founding Aliagas family's hands; a permit-register name variant.

candidateReview.name: Olympia Pizza #3
candidateReview.note: This is Olympia Pizza and Spaghetti House III at 516 15th Ave E on Capitol Hill, the third location of the Greek-founded Olympia Pizza & Spaghetti House family (I, II, III) that also runs the on-file Wallingford location (II) — a branch of the same business, not a separate one.

candidateReview.name: Pizza Colibri - Kc574
candidateReview.note: No trace of a pizzeria by this name anywhere in Seattle across multiple searches; "Kc574" reads like a ghost-kitchen/virtual-brand commissary code and turns up nothing in pizza guides, delivery-app listings or local news coverage.

candidateReview.name: Pizza Group LLC
candidateReview.note: The LLC behind Pizza Twist (né Chicago's Pizza With-A-Twist) at 510 Broadway E; the Indian-fusion pizza franchise was founded in Chicago in 2014 and by 2024 had grown to roughly 80 locations across about 19-20 U.S. states plus international units — a national chain, not a regional one.

candidateReview.name: Pizza Rasoi
candidateReview.note: Indian-Neapolitan fusion pizza pop-up/food truck tied to Tapster at 1011 Valley St; sources conflict on where it actually operates (one places it in Redmond instead) and none confirm it is still running as of 2026, only an undated pop-up listing and a single lukewarm review.

candidateReview.name: Pizzuto'S Italian Cafe
candidateReview.note: Branded and run as an Italian cafe at 5032 Wilson Ave S; its signature dishes are pastas (pasta Siciliana, prawns Pescara, house potato pasta) and chicken entrees, with pizza just one menu category among several rather than the core of the business.

directory.name: Jet City Pizza
directory.note: Puget Sound pizza-delivery chain founded in Kenmore in 1994, with branches across Washington State (Bothell, Newcastle, Marysville, Mount Vernon, Kent) and this Wedgwood store serving pizza, pasta and oven grinders; it has no locations outside the state, so it's a regional rather than a national chain.

directory.name: Pizza & Pasta Bar
directory.note: Pike Place Market Italian spot open since 2016, making its own sauces, pizza dough and meats from scratch and serving thin-crust pizza alongside customizable pasta; listed as a current Market tenant.

directory.name: Santorini Pizza & Pasta
directory.note: Family-run pizza-and-pasta restaurant since 1994 serving gourmet pizzas and pastas alongside Greek-influenced dishes like Greek salad and baklava, with dine-in, takeout, delivery and catering.
